work.composition: central plane on cyan ground, axial drip columns
work.description: Mixed-media collage on a cyan and grey ground incorporates warplane silhouettes, concentric black-and-white target rings at multiple positions, a leaping animal figure, vertical beaded or braided strands descending centrally, and scattered compact discs, chess pieces, and architectural blueprint fragments. Human facial elements, a hat-wearing figure, and grid-patterned photographic sections occupy the upper register.
work.title: Cyan Bombsight
